title: Lightning Circuit
description: 3-round circuit blending Bulgarian split squats, incline push-ups, planks and sprint bursts

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Toe taps (step)
exercises.instructions: Tap your foot on a step, alternating quickly

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Rear foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated support, easier variation

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms on the floor, body perfectly aligned, brace your core

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, knees above hip height, arms coordinated

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide apart, toes pointed outward

exercises.name: Burpees without push-up
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
